opciones.texto_opcion: Scale virtual warehouses independently from storage

opciones.texto_opcion: Merge storage and compute into a single monolithic cluster only

opciones.texto_opcion: Copy all tables to a larger filesystem on each user laptop

opciones.texto_opcion: Resize the storage layer to add CPU for each query

pregunta: A gaming studio (hourly batch windows, region westeurope) must: need authentication, query parsing, optimization, and transaction coordination. Which option fits best? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use the Cloud Services layer (metadata, security, optimizer, session state)
opciones.explicacion: Cloud Services handles login, parsing, optimization, DDL coordination, and metadata.

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable Cloud Services to reduce credit usage on SELECT queries
opciones.explicacion: Cloud Services is required for query orchestration.

opciones.texto_opcion: Offload all metadata to client-side browser storage
opciones.explicacion: Metadata is centralized in Cloud Services.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use only warehouse workers for login and RBAC enforcement
opciones.explicacion: Security and metadata services run in Cloud Services.

pregunta: For a travel platform workload with sub-second interactive queries: explain how all virtual warehouses access the same table data concurrently. Best choice (variant 4)?

opciones.texto_opcion: All warehouses read the same shared storage layer without copying full datasets per warehouse
opciones.explicacion: Snowflake uses shared storage; compute clusters are independent.

opciones.texto_opcion: Warehouses must export/import data between each other for every query
opciones.explicacion: No cross-warehouse data copy is required for reads.

opciones.texto_opcion: Only one warehouse may access a table at any time globally
opciones.explicacion: Multiple warehouses can query shared storage concurrently.

opciones.texto_opcion: Each warehouse maintains a private copy of every table on local disk permanently
opciones.explicacion: Persistent data is shared; local disk is cache only.

pregunta: A healthcare provider (~50,000 events/s, region brazilsouth) must: deploy Snowflake accounts in AWS, Azure, and GCP regions for residency requirements. Which option fits best? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Run Snowflake compute only on-premises and storage only in one cloud
opciones.explicacion: Snowflake is a cloud-native SaaS across AWS/Azure/GCP.

opciones.texto_opcion: Provision accounts in the cloud region on the desired cloud provider; cross-cloud is via replication/sharing patterns
opciones.explicacion: Snowflake runs natively on each major cloud; account location follows provider/region choice.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use a single on-prem Hadoop cluster as the storage layer
opciones.explicacion: Snowflake storage is cloud object storage managed by Snowflake.

opciones.texto_opcion: Move micro-partitions manually between clouds with FTP nightly
opciones.explicacion: Not how Snowflake manages storage.

pregunta: organize schemas, tables, and stages under a logical hierarchy for RBAC. Context: online marketplace, ~50,000 events/s. Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: User > Role > Query as the storage hierarchy
opciones.explicacion: That describes security, not object namespace.

opciones.texto_opcion: Warehouse > Table > Column only with no database concept
opciones.explicacion: Databases and schemas are first-class containers.

opciones.texto_opcion: Account > Database > Schema > Object (table, view, stage, etc.)
opciones.explicacion: Standard Snowflake namespace hierarchy for securable objects.

opciones.texto_opcion: Stage > Pipe > Stream as the top-level security boundary
opciones.explicacion: Those are objects inside schemas, not the root hierarchy.

pregunta: finance asks which layer consumption primarily drives warehouse spend. Context: logistics carrier, ~5 TB/day. Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Client JDBC driver licensing per developer seat
opciones.explicacion: Snowflake does not bill JDBC seats as the primary model.

opciones.texto_opcion: Cloud Services charges per SELECT row returned
opciones.explicacion: Cloud Services is not billed per row; compute credits dominate interactive workloads.

opciones.texto_opcion: Storage layer charges per SQL query parsed
opciones.explicacion: Storage is capacity/time based, not per-query parsing.

opciones.texto_opcion: Virtual warehouse compute credits while running/resuming

pregunta: A energy utility (near-real-time dashboards, region eastus) must: a user runs queries against PROD_DB.ANALYTICS.FACT_SALES. Which context must be set? Which option fits best? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: USE DATABASE and USE SCHEMA (or fully qualified names) to resolve objects
opciones.explicacion: Sessions need database/schema context or three-part names.

opciones.texto_opcion: Set the file format as session default instead of schema
opciones.explicacion: File format does not replace database/schema context for tables.

opciones.texto_opcion: Configure the storage layer region in the JDBC URL only
opciones.explicacion: Region is account-level; object resolution needs DB/schema.

opciones.texto_opcion: Only the warehouse name is required; database is inferred automatically
opciones.explicacion: Unqualified names require active database/schema context.

pregunta: For a industrial IoT platform workload with near-real-time dashboards: billions of micro-partitions must be tracked for pruning and Time Travel. Best choice (variant 4)?

opciones.texto_opcion: Each warehouse keeps its own unrelated copy of catalog metadata forever
opciones.explicacion: Metadata is centralized, not warehouse-local authoritative catalog.

opciones.explicacion: Partition min/max metadata enables pruning without scanning all files.

opciones.explicacion: Central metadata service drives optimization.

pregunta: A industrial IoT platform (strict GDPR residency, region australiaeast) must: nightly ETL needs 4X compute for two hours then minimal idle cost. Which option fits best? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Increase storage size to make queries faster without changing warehouse
opciones.explicacion: Query performance scaling is primarily warehouse compute.

opciones.texto_opcion: Duplicate all tables to four separate accounts during ETL
opciones.explicacion: Does not leverage warehouse elasticity.
